title: chat.php request body
description: Form-encoded POST body accepted by public/chat.php. The patient id and current encounter are taken from the OpenEMR session only; a pid in the body is not part of the contract and is ignored. The session cookie must belong to an authenticated user with patients/med and encounters/notes ACL.

csrf_token_form.description: OpenEMR CSRF token for the session, as embedded in the panel markup. Missing or wrong token: 403.

action.description: brief: assemble facts and return the verified briefing (cached by facts hash, prompt version and model). ask: answer a follow-up question about the same fact set.

question.description: ask only. Must contain at least one non-whitespace character; trimmed and truncated to 500 characters server-side.

facts_hash.description: ask only. The facts_hash from the briefing the thread started on. If the chart has changed since, the response is chat.chart-changed.response and no answer is produced.

transcript.description: ask only. JSON-encoded array of {role: user|assistant, text} turns held by the browser; the server keeps the last 10, truncates each text to 1000 characters, and ignores malformed input.

oneOf.description: ask needs the question and the facts_hash the thread started on.
